description: Attributes served requests, service time and payload bytes to the value of an HTTP request header that OpenTelemetry eBPF Instrumentation (OBI) captures on every server span. Use it to split infrastructure cost across tenants, customers or product areas without touching application code.

panels.description: Share of server spans in range that carry a value for the ${header} header. Anything below 100% means part of the load cannot be attributed and shows up as "(unattributed)".

targets.query:
let spans = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER"
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where "${service}" == "*" or ServiceName == "${service}"
| extend Tenant = tostring(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.request.header.${header}"][0])
| extend Tenant = iff(isempty(Tenant), "(unattributed)", Tenant)
| extend ServiceSeconds = todouble(datetime_diff('microsecond', EndTime, StartTime)) / 1000000.0
| extend BytesIn = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.request.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend BytesOut = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.response.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend IsError = tolower(SpanStatus) == "status_code_error";
spans
| summarize Attributed = countif(Tenant != "(unattributed)"), Total = count()
| project AttributionCoverage = iff(Total > 0, todouble(Attributed) / Total, real(null))

panels.title: Attribution coverage

panels.description: Service seconds is the summed wall clock duration of the server spans and is the most usable allocation key: it approximates the share of compute each tenant consumed. Bytes in/out come from the OBI span attributes http.request.body.size and http.response.body.size.

targets.query:
let spans = OTELTraces
| where $__timeFilter(StartTime)
| where SpanKind == "SPAN_KIND_SERVER"
| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
| where "${service}" == "*" or ServiceName == "${service}"
| extend Tenant = tostring(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.request.header.${header}"][0])
| extend Tenant = iff(isempty(Tenant), "(unattributed)", Tenant)
| extend ServiceSeconds = todouble(datetime_diff('microsecond', EndTime, StartTime)) / 1000000.0
| extend BytesIn = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.request.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend BytesOut = coalesce(todouble(parse_json(TraceAttributes)["http.response.body.size"]), 0.0)
| extend IsError = tolower(SpanStatus) == "status_code_error";
let totalServiceSeconds = toscalar(spans | summarize sum(ServiceSeconds));
let totalRequests = toscalar(spans | summarize count());
spans
| summarize
    Requests = count(),
    Errors = countif(IsError),
    ServiceSeconds = sum(ServiceSeconds),
    BytesIn = sum(BytesIn),
    BytesOut = sum(BytesOut)
  by Tenant
| extend RequestShare = iff(totalRequests > 0, todouble(Requests) / totalRequests, real(null))
| extend ServiceSecondsShare = iff(totalServiceSeconds > 0, ServiceSeconds / totalServiceSeconds, real(null))
| extend ErrorRatio = iff(Requests > 0, todouble(Errors) / Requests, real(null))
| project Tenant, Requests, RequestShare, ServiceSeconds, ServiceSecondsShare, BytesIn, BytesOut, Errors, ErrorRatio
| order by ServiceSeconds desc

| extend ServiceName = tostring(parse_json(ResourceAttributes)["service.name"])
